system.description: Spending a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait lets you run across water, walls, ceilings, or any relatively flat surface, needing only to keep moving to avoid falling (a Simple Test may be called on tricky surfaces). While active you may always declare Fair Escape given enough room to run, smashing through closed windows or slipping past blocked doorways. Attempting any other action while running requires a Simple Test: win to act normally, tie to keep running without acting, or lose and crash into your destination, potentially taking damage.
